scientific_integrity: All-dimensional proof based on orthogonal-projection containment, exact sign-cut classification, positive isotropic contact measure, and a determinant lower bound; finite exact checks are corroboration only. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The polytope is the unit-edge graphical zonotope of K_{p,q}, p,q>=2, endowed with the intrinsic Euclidean metric. The classification does not cover arbitrary bipartite graphs, edge weights, or other metrics. Originality is supported by specific inspected published comparisons but cannot exclude an equivalent uninspected formulation.
title: Exact Löwner ellipsoid and contact vertices of complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes
